hotels.vendor_name: SAii Lagoon Maldives, Curio Collection by Hilton
hotels.title: Maldives Family-Friendly Escape with Daily Breakfast, Nightly Dinner & Speedboat Transfers
hotels.description: Offering modern accommodations for couples and families at exceptional value, this dreamlike island oasis brings Maldives luxury within easier reach than ever before. Part of the incredible CROSSROADS Maldives complex, just a 15-minute boat ride from Malé, this sister property to the iconic Hard Rock Hotel Maldives is surrounded by the translucent waters of the Emboodhoo Lagoon. Enjoy seamless access to The Marina @ CROSSROADS, boasting even more dining, shopping and entertainment options. Taste your way across several onsite restaurants, find your zen at SAii Spa or plunge into the gleaming pool that looks out across the ocean. Set sail from the prestigious Yacht Marina @ CROSSROADS, expand your local know-how at the Marine Discovery Centre and Maldives Discovery Centre, or enjoy complimentary resort activities such as sunrise yoga, aqua gym classes and Zumba. Travelling with children? Koimala & Maalimi’s Junior Beach Club and Camp will entertain for hours and hours, so you can unwind in peace.

hotels.title: Award-Winning Maldives Icon with Daily Breakfast, Nightly Dinner & Speedboat Transfers
hotels.description: Experience island living, world-class dining and premier entertainment with one of the most celebrated leisure brands - just a 20-minute speedboat ride from Malé in the glorious Maldives. As part of the CROSSROADS Maldives complex, this private island resort features countless dining options, from the iconic Hard Rock Cafe® to a beachfront Mexican restaurant inspired by Frida Kahlo. With 14 dining spots and free-flow drinks, indulgence is always on the menu at this lavish hotel. Epic DJ nights, high-energy karaoke and live music keep the resort buzzing, while sun-soaked days call for lounging in the infinity pool with a drink in hand at the swim-up bar. Families can dive into martial arts classes, aerial aerobics, dance and water sports, while parents unwind with Rock Om® yoga and tension-melting treatments at the ROCK SPA. With thoughtful additions like complimentary use of personalised bicycles, kayaks and snorkels, every day is a new adventure in one of the world’s most sought-after destinations.
